blocks.content: Before making any change, read two things.
This explains what the project is, how to set it up, and how it works. Read it fully.
This contains the project's rules for contributors. It may define branch naming, commit style, testing steps, and how to write a pull request.

blocks.alt: GitHub repository page showing a CONTRIBUTING.md file with sections on setup and pull request guidelines

blocks.content: If this file exists, follow it exactly.
If it does not, look at existing merged pull requests. They show how the maintainer expects contributions to be written.
Use this space for your doubts about this lesson. Ask us anything that's confusing and our experts will provide explanations to help you understand.
